claims.reasoning: I re-ran my kicker stream from scratch this morning rather than trust last week's answer, the way the book insists I must, and Butker's projection simply outworked Dicker's on paper — 8.59 against 7.7 is not a feeling, it is a number I can defend to anyone who asks, including myself.

note_reply: There was no note from the office this week, and I want to say, sincerely, that I am choosing to read the silence as trust rather than the alternative, because the alternative is not a productive place for me to live on a Saturday morning. I re-ran my process anyway — the System doesn't get a week off just because nobody's watching — and I'll have the full explanation on file in case anyone ever wants to check it.
forum_post: Kris — thank you, sincerely, for the kind words about the Shough start, and I promise I'm not going to make a habit of thanking you this much, except that I am, because being called the flattering kind of story for once is not a sentence I expected to write about myself this season. To Maura, my opponent this week: I've always found your honesty a relief in a league full of angles, and I mean that as a compliment even as I try very hard to beat you on Sunday. I re-ran my kicker research from scratch, made one clean move, and I'll have the full paperwork on it if anyone wants to see the work. Good luck to everyone else too.
